items.title: [ECG] Register for NTU College of Computing and Data Science Pathways in Python 2027
items.author: Klyne Mary Ann
items.description:
The
College of Computing and Data Science
at Nanyang Technological University is inviting students from
Hwa Chong Institution
to join Pathways in Python 2027.
The programme offers two opportunities:
Python Intensives for students who want to build a strong foundation in Python; and
a Hackathon for students ready to apply their Python skills to a real-world challenge.
Students may register for the Python Intensives, the Hackathon or both. No prior coding experience is required for the Python Intensives.
-->
Register HERE!
Registration for the Python Intensives closes on Monday, 30 November 2026. Hackathon registration remains open until Sunday, 17 January 2027.

items.title: [SL] Calling for volunteers for The Warmth Project Expo
items.author: Chong Woon Tien
items.description:
Hey Hwachong!
Want to take part in the effort to support the elderly around us? Need a platform to publicise your service learning efforts? Or simply, like to see smiles on others’ faces? 🤔🤔
Well, we have the perfect opportunity for you! 😋😋
On 7th November, The Warmth Project will be holding its inaugural The Warmth Project Expo in collaboration with Moulmein-Cairnhill Youth Network & People’s Association 🤩🤩
The aim of this event is to provide bonding opportunities across generations through fun games, while there will also be an educational aspect to learn how we can better support the elders around us ❤️❤️
So, if you are…
Leading a Service Learning project that similarly furthers the welfare of the elderly, this is your opportunity to showcase your work to the community ‼️‼️
⁠A passionate individual who wants to give back to the community, this is your chance to volunteer and take part in our event 😇😇
So what are you waiting for? Sign up through this link now! 🎉🎉
https://forms.gle/rzsPfQL2JhF5TCFL6

items.title: December NOI 2026: Selection Test, Training Programme & Final Contest
items.author: Zhou Peng
items.description:
IMPORTANT: All students who register must select “Self Funded” under Funding on the application form.
Registration is open for the December NOI Selection Test, Training Programme and Final Contest at
NUS School of Computing
.
SELECTION TEST
Date: 2 December 2026
Time: 10:00 am–6:00 pm
Reporting: Students should report by 10:30 am for a briefing.
Lunch: 11:30 am–1:00 pm, at students’ own expense
Fee: S$20, inclusive of 9% GST
Registration:
https://app.comp.nus.edu.sg/app/catalyst/login/DecNOISelectionTest
Registration deadline: 22 November 2026, 11:59 pm
Who needs to take the Selection Test?
For the Basic Course, the stated eligibility is a CS1, CS2 or CS3 Certificate of Proficiency, Merit or Distinction, or an NOI Silver or Gold Medal. Other students must take the Selection Test to be considered.
For the Advanced Course, the stated eligibility is a CS2 or CS3 Certificate of Proficiency, Merit or Distinction, or an NOI Silver or Gold Medal. Other students must take the Selection Test to be considered.
DECEMBER NOI TRAINING PROGRAMME
The programme has Basic and Advanced courses. Students who register for the Training Programme are automatically registered for the Final Contest and do not need to register separately.
Training dates: 2, 4, 7, 9, 11, 14, 16, 18, 21, 23, 28 and 30 December 2026
Time: 9:00 am–5:00 pm
Venue: NUS School of Computing
Fee: S$120, inclusive of 9% GST
Registration:
https://app.comp.nus.edu.sg/app/catalyst/login/DECNOI
Registration deadline: 22 November 2026, 11:59 pm
FINAL CONTEST ONLY
Students who wish to enter the Final Contest without attending the Training Programme must register separately.
Date: 30 December 2026
Expected end time: Around 6:00 pm
Fee: S$20, inclusive of 9% GST
Registration:
https://app.comp.nus.edu.sg/app/catalyst/login/DecNOIContest
Registration deadline: 16 December 2026, 11:59 pm
For questions, contact Irene Ong at
ionghn@nus.edu.sg
.
See the attached screenshot for the Funding option students should select.
IMPORTANT: All students who register must select “Self Funded” under Funding on the application form.
